topic: What interference mitigation techniques are viable for overlapping service transmissions across geographically dispersed ground stations?
consensus_response: Viable techniques include rate-splitting, beamforming, and adaptive frequency allocation. These methods reduce co-channel interference, enhancing transmission reliability. Polarization diversity also improves transmission integrity by minimizing mutual interference, increasing system capacity.
reference_context: Research highlights importance of interference mitigation in satellite-terrestrial systems, citing polarization correlation coefficients and atmospheric conditions as key factors.
